criteria.reason: Evidence is stale: the parse transcript (mtime 1794415461) predates this run's freshness floor (1794415500), and .github/workflows/ci.yml was changed after it (file mtime 1794415491, commit 32f32c2 'end-of-run review edits' added a timeout and continue-on-error to the cache step and per-attempt timeouts to the install). The transcript describes the pre-review workflow; re-run the parse and actionlint against the current ci.yml.

Evidence is stale (same transcript as FS-1, captured before commit 32f32c2 changed ci.yml). Its arithmetic (install bounds 5 min + npm ci 3s + Jest 87s = 390s vs 600s) omits the cache step's new 1-minute bound; redo the arithmetic over every bounded step before Run Jest in the current workflow.

Evidence is stale (same transcript as FS-1, captured before commit 32f32c2 rewrote the download command to 'timeout -k 5 80 npx playwright install chromium'). Re-parse the current ci.yml to show the download carries no --with-deps and apt work stays in its own bounded step.

All 96 suites ran and reported a result with Chromium unavailable ('Test Suites: 8 failed, 88 passed, 96 total'; 3451 tests). No suite was skipped or blocked. Five non-browser suites report FAIL locally for reasons unrelated to Chromium: four fail identically with the browser present (it1-withbrowser-subset.txt: status.test.js mock-fs TypeError under local Node; three skill-md.test.js cp -RL chmod EPERM under /tmp), and custody.test.js is the known all-digit-hash flake (passed on re-run with the browser).

The literal count cannot be observed on this machine: 8 suites fail without Chromium, but 5 of them fail for local reasons regardless of Chromium (Node version breaks mock-fs in status.test.js; sandboxed /tmp rejects cp -RL chmod in three skill-md tests; custody.test.js is a known flake). The differential supports the intent: the only suites that change state with the browser present are design-bundle, design-render and design-render-walk, all of which fail in design-render.js launch() with Chromium missing. A clean baseline needs the CI runner (Node 20, ubuntu-24.04), which verification.md section 5 says cannot be reproduced from here.

The Jest half holds: the no-browser run ends JEST_EXIT=1. The other half (Run Jest carries no continue-on-error) rests on it1-parse.txt, which predates commit 32f32c2's change to ci.yml and is stale; re-capture it against the current workflow.

Every failing test in the three browser suites (design-bundle, design-render, design-render-walk) reports 'ToolError: Playwright's Chromium is not installed: run `npx playwright install chromium`', thrown from design-render.js launch(), which names the missing browser.
